# Scenario A — New Inventory Web Application

Workflow: `new-product-development`.

Controlled fixture selection: business/product, requirements/design, architecture, implementation, QA, security, release, and SRE roles. The expected journey is business requirements → PRD → architecture → UI/UX → planning → implementation → testing → security → staging → human production approval → deployment → monitoring. Production approval remains `NEEDS_HUMAN_APPROVAL`; this fixture does not claim a deployment.
